scoring_justification: The main claim is the UV reflectance enhancement trend (R>1 for small periods, R≤1 for large period and planar). Exact R values depend on solver implementation and not critical; primary check is structural. Planar reference is exactly 1 by definition, so that is checked with tight tolerance.

outputs.description: Total normalized reflectance R computed by RCWA for sinusoidal gratings with specified parameters. Reflectance values are compared to a checker-recomputed reference within tolerance; structural trend (R > 1 for small periods) is also assessed.

steps.description: Verifies planar reference rows (R≈1) and structural trend (R>1 for d=0.256,0.276,0.315; R≤1 for d=0.495).
